intro: Toronto rewards visitors with world-class food, museums, waterfront and lively neighbourhoods. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: TTC subway (Line 1 and 2) and streetcars cover downtown well; tap a PRESTO card or contactless card.
Buses and streetcars run frequently; King Street streetcar is transit-only through the core.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft both operate widely.
Driving is grid-easy but downtown parking is costly and rush hour is heavy.
Walking is best downtown; bike-share (Bike Share Toronto) is handy along the waterfront.
A short free ferry and pedestrian tunnel link Billy Bishop Airport to the mainland.

cn_tower.name: CN Tower
cn_tower.price_text: ≈ CAD 40–50 adult general admission; check on the day
cn_tower.tip: Book a timed ticket online and go near sunset for day and night views in one visit.

rom.name: Royal Ontario Museum
rom.price_text: ≈ CAD 20–30 adult; check on the day
rom.tip: Start with the dinosaur galleries, then the crystal-wing architecture from outside.

distillery.name: Distillery District
distillery.price_text: Free to walk; shops and tours cost extra
distillery.hours: Public lanes always open; shops roughly 10:00–19:00
distillery.tip: Come in the early evening for brick lanes, patios and photos without midday crowds.

ripleys.name: Ripley's Aquarium of Canada
ripleys.price_text: ≈ CAD 35–50 adult; book online for lower prices
ripleys.hours: Daily, usually 09:00–21:00; check on the day
ripleys.tip: Book the first morning slot and head straight to the shark tunnel before it fills.

st_lawrence.name: St. Lawrence Market
st_lawrence.price_text: Free entry; food paid per item
st_lawrence.tip: Go Saturday morning for the full market and grab a peameal bacon sandwich.

ago.name: Art Gallery of Ontario
ago.price_text: ≈ CAD 20–30 adult; free for some ages; check on the day
ago.tip: The Frank Gehry staircase and the Group of Seven rooms are the highlights.

bmo_field.name: BMO Field
bmo_field.price_text: Match tickets vary; check on the day
bmo_field.tip: Check the Toronto FC or Argonauts schedule and buy tickets ahead for weekend games.

wonderland.name: Canada's Wonderland
wonderland.price_text: ≈ CAD 45–70 day ticket; check on the day
wonderland.tip: Arrive at opening and ride the big coasters first before lines build.

casa_loma.name: Casa Loma
casa_loma.price_text: ≈ CAD 35–45 adult; check on the day
casa_loma.tip: Climb the tower for the city view and take the audio guide for the history.

centreville.name: Centreville Amusement Park
centreville.price_text: Ride tickets or day passes; check on the day
centreville.tip: Combine the ferry ride with a few hours here; it suits younger kids best.

fort_york.name: Fort York
fort_york.price_text: ≈ CAD 10–20 adult; check on the day
fort_york.tip: Pair it with a walk along the nearby waterfront and Garrison Common.

kensington.name: Kensington Market
kensington.price_text: Free to wander; food paid per item
kensington.tip: Come hungry and graze: tacos, cheese shops and bakeries are the draw.

massacre.name: Massacre of the Innocents
massacre.price_text: Included with Art Gallery of Ontario admission; check on the day
massacre.hours: Same as the Art Gallery of Ontario; closed Monday
massacre.tip: It is a painting inside the Art Gallery of Ontario, so check the room and gallery hours before you go.

nathan_phillips.name: Nathan Phillips Square
nathan_phillips.price_text: Free; ice rental in winter costs extra
nathan_phillips.tip: Photograph the Toronto sign and City Hall, then skate here in winter.

pizza_pizza.name: Pizza Pizza
pizza_pizza.price_text: ≈ CAD 8–20 per person; check on the day
pizza_pizza.hours: Many branches open late; hours vary by location
pizza_pizza.tip: A cheap, late-night slice chain with branches all over downtown.

roy_thomson.name: Roy Thomson Hall
roy_thomson.price_text: Concert tickets vary; check on the day
roy_thomson.hours: Box office and event times vary
roy_thomson.tip: Check the Toronto Symphony Orchestra schedule and book ahead for weekend concerts.

fisher_library.name: Thomas Fisher Rare Book Library
fisher_library.hours: Weekdays only, usually daytime; check on the day
fisher_library.tip: The glass tower of old books is the photo; visit on a weekday and keep quiet.

tim_hortons.name: Tim Hortons
tim_hortons.price_text: ≈ CAD 2–10 per person; check on the day
tim_hortons.hours: Many branches open early to late; hours vary
tim_hortons.tip: Grab a coffee and a box of Timbits for a cheap Canadian snack.

tiff.name: Toronto International Film Festival
tiff.price_text: Tickets vary by screening; check on the day
tiff.hours: Runs each September; venues across downtown
tiff.tip: If you visit in September, book screenings early; many sell out fast.

island_ferry.name: Toronto Islands Ferry
island_ferry.price_text: ≈ CAD 8–10 return adult; check on the day
island_ferry.hours: Usually early morning to late evening; seasonal
island_ferry.tip: Take the ferry to Centre Island and walk back for the skyline view from the water.

toronto_zoo.name: Toronto Zoo
toronto_zoo.price_text: ≈ CAD 30–40 adult; check on the day
toronto_zoo.tip: It is large and spread out; wear good shoes and plan the pandas and polar bears first.

uoft.name: University of Toronto
uoft.tip: Walk from Queen's Park through the old stone quads; it feels like Oxford for an hour.

harbourfront.name: Harbourfront and Queens Quay walk
harbourfront.tip: Walk the waterfront west from Union Station for lake views and patios.

queens_park.name: Queen's Park and Ontario Legislative Building
queens_park.hours: Park always open; building tours weekday daytime
queens_park.tip: A quiet green stop between the Royal Ontario Museum and the University of Toronto.

graffiti_alley.name: Graffiti Alley walk
graffiti_alley.tip: A short lane of street art near Queen West; best photos in soft daylight.

st_lawrence_hall.name: St. Lawrence Hall and neighbourhood walk
st_lawrence_hall.tip: Combine with the market for a short old-Toronto walk.

high_park.name: High Park
high_park.tip: Toronto's big green escape; go in spring for cherry blossoms.

hockey_hall.name: Hockey Hall of Fame
hockey_hall.price_text: ≈ CAD 20–30 adult; check on the day
hockey_hall.tip: Good rainy-day stop near Union; see the Stanley Cup.

stays.why: Walk to the CN Tower, the waterfront and the main subway lines. Easiest base for a first visit.
Quiet, upscale blocks near the ROM and good restaurants. Two subway stops from downtown.
Next to King West bars, theatres and the Rogers Centre. Lively at night, sometimes noisy.
Cobbled, car-free lanes with galleries and cafés. A short streetcar ride east of the core.

food: Try a peameal bacon sandwich at St. Lawrence Market; go early, many stalls close by mid-afternoon.
Chinatown and Kensington Market are close together: dim sum, dumplings and cheap tacos in one walk.
Poutine, butter tarts and a Toronto-style brunch are the local staples; expect CAD 15–30 for a main.
Book dinner ahead on weekends in King West and Yorkville; walk-ins are hard after 7pm.
Tipping is expected: about 15–20% on the bill, and it is often added to larger groups.
more_time: Take the short ferry to the Toronto Islands for skyline views and a picnic; check the day's schedule.
Ride the subway to the Royal Ontario Museum and the AGO in one day if museums are your thing.
Day trip to Niagara Falls by train or bus; it is a long day, so start early.
